title: Comparison of Beta-hCG Levels When Using Venous Puncture Blood and Peripheral Finger Stick Blood
official: Comparison of Beta-hCG Levels When Using Venous Puncture Blood and Peripheral Finger Stick Blood
summary: The objective of his study is to quantitatively evaluate a patient's pregnancy status using their beta-hCG levels when using venipuncture blood vs peripheral blood.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 19 years of age or older
* known pregnancy status either via urine, serum, or imaging results
* current patient of the Nebraska Medicine OB/GYN clinic

Exclusion Criteria:

\- No meeting the inclusion criteria
